root_cause: The corpus was authored as a DESIGN/SPEC body whose only licence-bearing construct is the TechnologyAdmission `license_state`/`license_ref` field describing THIRD-PARTY technologies. No artefact in the corpus ever answers the question "under what terms may a consumer use THIS material?" — so the question was never posed, never answered, and the downstream gate could only record a gap.
mechanism: field-scope confusion: `license_state` is an INPUT field about a candidate technology, and it was the only licence-shaped surface in the corpus; the corpus-own licence question has no surface at all.
not_the_cause: a wrong SPDX id (none was ever chosen)
blast_radius: licence gate + PUBLICATION_APPROVED + any downstream consumer's redistribution decision
minimal_fix_that_addresses_cause: give the corpus-own licence question its own explicit, machine-readable surface, and a prepared owner decision
